    114                                                          // 3. Apply Saturation to fit into 12 bits

    150                                                      end

    17                                               bf_en:enable the butterfly unit
    18                                               fifo_mux_sel:direct the input of the FIFO (from input b - from the butterfly diff)
    19                                               rot_en:asserted when the output is diff so it enables the mutliplier (rotator)
    20                                               twiddle_sel:it's the superscript in the twilde factor w^(twiddle_sel)
    21                                               valid_out:Asserted when there is a valid output of the stage
    22                                               
    23                                               
    24                                               Parameters 
    25                                               parameter (FIFO_DEPTH):the size of the FIFO 
    26                                               */
    27                                               
    28                                               /*We have 4 main states 
    29                                               IDLE_S : do noting
    30                                               FILL_S : store the input in the FIFO
    31                                               BF_S   : enable the butterfly and do the calculation (+,-)
    32                                               DRAIN_S: move the difference from the FIFO to the multiplier then to the next stage
    33                                               */
    34                                               
    35                                               localparam IDLE_S  = 2'b00,
    36                                                          FILL_S  = 2'b01,
    37                                                          BF_S    = 2'b11,
    38                                                          DRAIN_S = 2'b10;
    39                                               
    40                                               // FIFO MUX selection
    41                                               localparam SEL_BF_DIFF   = 1'b0,
    42                                                          SEL_STG_INPUT = 1'b1;
    43                                               
    44                                               // output MUX selection
    45                                               localparam SEL_FIFO_OUT = 1'b0,
    46                                                          SEL_BF_SUM   = 1'b1;
    47                                                         
    48                                               
    49                                               reg [1:0] current_state, next_state;
    50                                               
    51                                               wire count_done;
    52                                               wire count_en;
    53                                               
    54              1                        778     assign rot_en = (next_state == DRAIN_S);
    55              1                        778     assign valid_out = (next_state == BF_S) || (next_state == DRAIN_S);
    56                                               
    57              1                        390     assign count_en = (current_state != IDLE_S);
    58                                               wire  [$clog2(FIFO_DEPTH)-1: 0] glb_count;
    59                                               
    60                                               /*this counter is used to move from state to another  */
    61                                               fft_modulo_N_counter #(.N(FIFO_DEPTH)) glb_counter_u0 (
    62                                               .clk(clk),
    63                                               .rst_n(rst_n),
    64                                               .count_en(count_en),
    65                                               .count_done(count_done),
    66                                               .count(glb_count)
    67                                               );
    68                                               
    69                                               /*this counter is used to determine the source of the current output (sum or diff) so it enable and disable the rot_en */
    70                                               fft_modulo_N_counter #(.N(FIFO_DEPTH)) rot_counter_u1 (
    71                                               .clk(clk),
    72                                               .rst_n(rst_n),
    73                                               .count_en(rot_en),
    74                                               .count_done(rot_count_done),
    75                                               .count(twiddle_sel)
    76                                               );
    77                                               
    78                                               /* next_stage -> current state*/
    79              1                        779     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    80                                                   if(!rst_n) begin
    81              1                          2             current_state <= IDLE_S;
    82                                                   end
    83                                                   else begin
    84              1                        777             current_state <= next_state;
    85                                                   end
    86                                               end
    87                                               
    88                                               /* determine the next_state based on the input and the current state*/
    89              1                        780     always @(*) begin
    90              1                        780         next_state = IDLE_S;
    91                                                   case(current_state)
    92                                                       IDLE_S: begin
    93                                                           if(valid_in) begin
    94              1                          2                     next_state = FILL_S;
    95                                                           end
    96                                                           else begin
    97              1                          3                     next_state = IDLE_S;
    98                                                           end
    99                                                       end
    100                                                      
    101                                                      FILL_S: begin
    102                                                          if(count_done) begin
    103             1                          2                     next_state = BF_S;
    104                                                          end
    105                                                          else begin
    106             1                          2                     next_state = FILL_S;
    107                                                          end
    108                                                      end
    109                                              
    110                                                      BF_S: begin
    111                                                          if(count_done) begin
    112             1                        194                     next_state = DRAIN_S;
    113                                                          end
    114                                                          else begin
    115             1                        192                     next_state = BF_S;
    116                                                          end            
    117                                                      end
    118                                              
    119                                                      DRAIN_S: begin
    120                                                          if(count_done) begin
    121                                                              if(valid_in)
    122             1                        190                         next_state = BF_S;
    123                                                              else
    124             1                          2                         next_state = IDLE_S;
    125                                                          end
    126                                                          else begin
    127             1                        192                     next_state = DRAIN_S;
    128                                                          end                 
    129                                                      end
    130             1                          1             default: next_state = IDLE_S;
    131                                                  endcase
    132                                              end
    133                                              
    134                                              /* determine the output based on the next state (current state and input) and the current state*/
    135             1                        775     always @(*) begin
    136             1                        775         fifo_mux_sel = SEL_STG_INPUT;
    137             1                        775         out_mux_sel =  SEL_FIFO_OUT;
    138             1                        775         bf_en = 1'b0;
    139                                                  case(next_state) 
    140                                                      IDLE_S: begin
    141             1                          3             fifo_mux_sel = SEL_STG_INPUT;
    142             1                          3             out_mux_sel =  SEL_FIFO_OUT;
    143             1                          3             bf_en = 1'b0;            
    144                                                      end
    145                                              
    146                                                      FILL_S: begin
    147             1                          4                 fifo_mux_sel = SEL_STG_INPUT;
    148             1                          4                 bf_en        = 1'b0;
    149                                                      end
    150                                              
    151                                                      BF_S: begin
    152             1                        384                 fifo_mux_sel = SEL_BF_DIFF;
    153             1                        384                 out_mux_sel  = SEL_BF_SUM;
    154             1                        384                 bf_en        = 1'b1;            
    155                                                      end
    156                                              
    157                                                      DRAIN_S: begin
    158             1                        384                 fifo_mux_sel = SEL_STG_INPUT;
    159             1                        384                 out_mux_sel  = SEL_FIFO_OUT;
    160             1                        384                 bf_en        = 1'b0;            
    161                                                      end
    162                                              
    163                                                      default: begin
    164             1                    ***0***                 fifo_mux_sel = SEL_STG_INPUT;
    165             1                    ***0***                 out_mux_sel =  SEL_FIFO_OUT;
    166             1                    ***0***                 bf_en = 1'b0;

  File ../rtl/fft_stg_fsm.v
    1                                                module fft_stg_fsm #(
    2                                                    parameter FIFO_DEPTH = 4
    3                                                )(
    4                                                    input  wire                           clk, rst_n, valid_in, 
    5                                                    output reg                            out_mux_sel, bf_en, fifo_mux_sel,
    6                                                    output wire                           rot_en,
    7                                                    output wire [$clog2(FIFO_DEPTH)-1: 0] twiddle_sel , 
    8                                                    output wire valid_out
    9                                                );
    10                                               /* input - output - Parameters definition 
    11                                               inputs:
    12                                               valid_in : Asserted when there is a valid input and Enable the FFT block
    13                                               clk , rst_n
    14                                               
    15                                               outputs :
    16                                               out_mux_sel:direct the output (from butterfly sum - from FIFO)
    17                                               bf_en:enable the butterfly unit
    18                                               fifo_mux_sel:direct the input of the FIFO (from input b - from the butterfly diff)
    19                                               rot_en:asserted when the output is diff so it enables the mutliplier (rotator)
    20                                               twiddle_sel:it's the superscript in the twilde factor w^(twiddle_sel)
    21                                               valid_out:Asserted when there is a valid output of the stage
    22                                               
    23                                               
    24                                               Parameters 
    25                                               parameter (FIFO_DEPTH):the size of the FIFO 
    26                                               */
    27                                               
    28                                               /*We have 4 main states 
    29                                               IDLE_S : do noting
    30                                               FILL_S : store the input in the FIFO
    31                                               BF_S   : enable the butterfly and do the calculation (+,-)
    32                                               DRAIN_S: move the difference from the FIFO to the multiplier then to the next stage
    33                                               */
    34                                               
    35                                               localparam IDLE_S  = 2'b00,
    36                                                          FILL_S  = 2'b01,
    37                                                          BF_S    = 2'b11,

    46                                                          SEL_BF_SUM   = 1'b1;
    47                                                         
    48                                               
    49                                               reg [1:0] current_state, next_state;
    50

    53                                               
    54              1                       6154     assign rot_en = (next_state == DRAIN_S);
    55              1                       6154     assign valid_out = (next_state == BF_S) || (next_state == DRAIN_S);

    58                                               wire  [$clog2(FIFO_DEPTH)-1: 0] glb_count;

    71                                               .clk(clk),
    72                                               .rst_n(rst_n),
    73                                               .count_en(rot_en),
    74                                               .count_done(rot_count_done),
    75                                               .count(twiddle_sel)

    77                                               
    78                                               /* next_stage -> current state*/
    79              1                       6155     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin

    89              1                       6156     always @(*) begin

    94              1                          2                     next_state = FILL_S;
    95                                                           end
    96                                                           else begin

    98                                                           end
    99                                                       end
    100                                                      
    101                                                      FILL_S: begin
    102                                                          if(count_done) begin
    103             1                          2                     next_state = BF_S;
    104                                                          end
    105                                                          else begin

    108                                                      end
    109                                              
    110                                                      BF_S: begin
    111                                                          if(count_done) begin
    112             1                       1538                     next_state = DRAIN_S;
    113                                                          end
    114                                                          else begin
    115             1                       1536                     next_state = BF_S;
    116                                                          end            
    117                                                      end
    118                                              
    119                                                      DRAIN_S: begin
    120                                                          if(count_done) begin
    121                                                              if(valid_in)
    122             1                       1534                         next_state = BF_S;
    123                                                              else
    124             1                          2                         next_state = IDLE_S;
    125                                                          end
    126                                                          else begin
    127             1                       1536                     next_state = DRAIN_S;
    128                                                          end                 
    129                                                      end

    131                                                  endcase
    132                                              end
    133                                              
    134                                              /* determine the output based on the next state (current state and input) and the current state*/
    135             1                       6151     always @(*) begin

    60              1                    ***0***                 L_i = temp_mult_out_i[12]; R_i = temp_mult_out_i[11]; S_i = |temp_mult_out_i[10:0];
    60              2                    ***0***     
    60              3                    ***0***     
    61                                                           
    62              1                    ***0***                 round_bit_r = R_r & (L_r | S_r);
    63              1                    ***0***                 round_bit_i = R_i & (L_i | S_i);

    65              1                    ***0***                 rounded_mult_r = (temp_mult_out_r >>> 12) + $signed({1'b0, round_bit_r});

    74                                                       /* -----------------------------------------------------------------
    75                                                          2. APPLY SATURATION TO 12 BITS
    76                                                          ----------------------------------------------------------------- */

    78                                                       if (rounded_mult_r > 26'sd2047)

    97                                                   /* the output from the summition */    
    98                                                   else begin
    99                                                       //No extending at all 
    100                                                      if(Q_sum==Q_in && Q_sum==Q_mult) begin

    132                                                          // 3. Calculate the Convergent Round bit

    138             1                    ***0***                 rounded_sum_i = (inter_sum_i >>> 2) + $signed({1'b0, round_bit_i});
